### Added

- *(connectivity)* Describe the kagent MCPServer for the developer portal in [#1390](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1390) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians)
- *(default-agent)* Tag the General Assistant general and platform in [#1397](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1397) by [@Rotfuks](https://github.com/Rotfuks)
- Support agent-manager 3.x and on-demand GitHub grants in [#1375](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1375) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson)
- *(default-agent)* Make the General Assistant proactive in [#1399](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1399) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians)
- *(connectivity)* Admit kagent's own HelmRelease in the kagent namespace from its writers in [#1402](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1402) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)

### Fixed

- *(connectivity)* Bound MCPServer descriptions, mirror kagent's and describe mcp-kubernetes in [#1398](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1398) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians)
- *(operator)* Take agent-platform-operator 0.4.x, so organizations with a model and an agent run a warm worker in [#1405](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1405) by [@fiunchinho](https://github.com/fiunchinho)
- *(agent-manager)* Follow stable 3.x charts in [#1407](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1407) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson)
- *(substrate)* Retry a failed upgrade instead of rolling it back in [#1401](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1401) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/compare/v4.180.2...v4.181.0
